title: 涂料飞溅Logo
prompt: make a hyper-realistic 3D render of the attached logo, formed by glossy liquid paint splashes. Paint sculpts the outline using the exact palette from the reference. Smooth, fluid high-gloss splashes catch highlights; logo floats on pure white.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造超写实3D涂料飞溅Logo，以高光泽液态飞溅塑造轮廓，呈现流畅亮丽的视觉效果，适合创意行业品牌设计，让标志在纯白背景上脱颖而出。
